properties.description: After a synchronous reset edge both response valids must be clear. Reset cancels queued obligations. After 128 uninterrupted no-offer, ready-high, reset-low cycles, the tracked epoch must have drained, including any partial input frame.

Every presented data byte, even when blocked, must match the oldest unconsumed byte justified by previously accepted input. Preserve the first eight bytes and append zero padding only after a short input frame completes.

Every presented data beat must carry the expected last marker: at byte four for padded frames, at the input end for lengths four through eight, and at byte eight for truncated frames. Partial accepted prefixes are tracked without waiting for frame completion.

Every presented status must match the oldest completed input frame not yet consumed on the status channel, with correct original length, clamped length, padding flag and truncation flag. Status and data retire independently.
A blocked data response must retain valid, data and last across the next edge, except when that edge performs synchronous reset.
A blocked status response must retain valid and every status field across the next edge, except when that edge performs synchronous reset, independently of data-channel progress.
